surface: City of Olympia Public Portal — SmartGov ReportsView

capture.captured_via: Ordinary-visitor page load in a normal browser, in-region Tacoma IP (AS14677 City of Tacoma). No bot/WAF bypass. Olympia was never network-blocked (docs/source-policy.md lists it as the top P1 permit-stage GAP, not blocked) — this confirms the public reports are reachable and enumerable.
capture.vendor: SmartGov (Granicus) public portal; reports engine is Exago hosted at reports-new.smartgovcommunity.com

report_open_mechanism: Each catalog row is an anchor with href javascript:ReportsView.viewReport('<exago_guid>', 'Exago'). Invoking it navigates to https://reports-new.smartgovcommunity.com/exago/ExagoHome.aspx and loads an iframe https://reports-new.smartgovcommunity.com/exago/ExecuteExport.aspx?eid=<runtimeId>&bt=Chrome

format_reality.probed_2026_07_19: PDF-ONLY in practice. ExecuteExport.aspx eit=0 (and eit=1) return application/pdf 200 with content-disposition filename '<Report Name>.pdf'. Every non-PDF export type tried (eit=3 Excel, eit=4 CSV, eit=5, eit=6) returns HTTP 500 'Object reference not set to an instance of an object.' (server-side NullReferenceException). So the earlier 'Exago engine supports HTML/Excel/CSV' finding is the ENGINE'S capability, but SmartGov's Olympia config 500s on non-PDF exports — the adapter path is PDF download + positioned-text parse (packages/documents extractPdfTextItems / pdfToMarkdown), NOT a clean tabular export.
format_reality.eid_is_session_bound: The ExecuteExport eid is tied to the browser's Exago session (HttpOnly cookie) AND is single-execution: a curl with the eid but no session returns the 500 page, and re-fetching a DIFFERENT eit on the same eid after it has been read once also 500s. Capture path: open the report fresh from the portal (ViewReport?reportId=<guid>&reportType=Exago -> ExagoHome mints a new eid in its ExecuteExport iframe), then fetch eit=0 ONCE.

capture_2026_07_19.captured_via: Genuine in-region visitor (in-app browser, Tacoma AS14677). Opened the report from the Olympia public portal (ReportsView.viewReport -> ViewReport?reportId=<guid>&reportType=Exago), read the fresh ExecuteExport eid from the ExagoHome iframe, fetched eit=0 in-session, and bridged the bytes to disk via a loopback sink (never through automation that spoofs the session). No bot/WAF bypass. Downloads owner-approved 2026-07-19.
capture_2026_07_19.report_coverage: Permits ISSUED 06/19/2026 through 07/19/2026 (trailing 30 days). Report Run 2026-07-19 13:56:22.
capture_2026_07_19.structure: 60 pages, ~3178 positioned-text lines. Permits are grouped under permit-CATEGORY section headers (e.g. 'Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU)', 'Block Party Street Closure ...', 'Civil Engineering'). Each category is a table with x-anchored columns: Permit Number (x~38), Date Issued (x~106), Site Address (x~157), Project Name (x~249), Project Description (x~340), Applicant (x~456). Records wrap across multiple lines (continuation lines carry a subset of columns forward). Each category ends with a printed 'Total <Category> Permits: N' (reconciliation anchor). Page footer 'Pg. N'.
capture_2026_07_19.fields_absent: No phone, no contractor licence, no valuation, no parcel, no coordinates. Applicant name is the only contact-identity column (people AND businesses) — feeds organizations[] name-only (no phone identifiers, unlike Pierce PALS).
capture_2026_07_19.parser_notes: county=Thurston, permittingJurisdiction='City of Olympia', normalizedStage=permit_issued, issueDate=Date Issued, externalId=Permit Number (note formats like '26-3143' and 'EVNT - 0240'), permitType=category header. Reconcile parsed rows-per-category against the printed 'Total ... Permits: N' via checkInvariants.
